dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature transitioning from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse pixel-radius geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base width is approximately 1.3 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc; however, precise pixel boundaries are partially obscured by high-luminance specular highlights.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust extension with a length approximately 1.5 times the thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the transition point from melon to rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular reflections and light caustics on the dorsal and lateral skin surfaces due to water-surface light refraction.
